description: This file defines the MCPServerManager class, which manages MCP (Multi-Cloud Protocol) servers, including their registration, configuration loading, tool and resource fetching, OAuth discovery, and interaction with MCP clients. It supports dynamic loading of OpenAPI specifications, secure credential handling, permission checks, and tool invocation workflows.

classes.name: MCPServerManager
classes.description: This class manages the lifecycle, configuration, and interactions with MCP servers, including registration, OAuth metadata discovery, tool/resource retrieval, and security permission checks.

methods.description: Returns combined MCP server registry including configured and runtime registered servers.

methods.description: Loads MCP server configurations from a provided dictionary, including OpenAPI spec processing and tool registration.
